name: 5-MeO-MsBT
summary: 5-MeO-MsBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-methyl-N-sec-butyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families. It emerged as a novel designer drug online in December 2022. More specifically, its chemical synthesis and the claimed properties and effects of 5-MeO-MsBT were posted on a specialized psychoactive drug forum.

pharmacology.text: Its effects were reported to include a tryptamine-like warmth or fuzzy feeling, tactile and music enhancement, enhanced mood, confusion, mild paranoia, weak psychedelic effects and self-detachment at higher doses, and an antidepressant-like psychedelic afterglow.

uses.text: It emerged as a novel designer drug online in December 2022. The drug has not otherwise been encountered, for instance sold online or in drug seizures, as of 2023.

sideEffects.en: The person who first described it online reported warmth, enhanced touch and music, improved mood, confusion, mild paranoia and a sense of detachment. Reports like this are single accounts, not studied findings, and nothing is known about its risks.
sideEffects.zh: 最初在網路上描述它的人提到溫暖感、觸覺與音樂感受增強、情緒改善、意識混亂、輕微多疑與疏離感。這類報告只是個別說法，而非研究結論，它的風險也完全不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 最初在网络上描述它的人提到温暖感、触觉与音乐感受增强、情绪改善、意识混乱、轻微多疑与疏离感。这类报告只是个别说法，而非研究结论，它的风险也完全不明。

fact.en: It is one of several tryptamines whose synthesis and reported effects first appeared on the internet rather than in a scientific journal, in its case in December 2022.
fact.zh: 它屬於少數幾種合成方法與使用報告先出現在網路上、而不是學術期刊上的色胺；就它而言，時間是2022年12月。
fact.zhHans: 它属于少数几种合成方法与使用报告先出现在网络上、而不是学术期刊上的色胺；就它而言，时间是2022年12月。
